newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-S&P assigns A minus to Korea's LTCB Kangaroo.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-S&P assigns A minus to Korea's LTCB Kangaroo.

text.p: Standard and Poor's Corp said on Wednesday it assigned its A minus rating to Korea Long Term Credit Bank's A$125 million floating rate notes due December 1999.
S&P said the outlook is stable and the rating reflects LTCB's sound financial profile and good asset quality.
The three-year floating rate note was priced on December 12 at 21 basis points over the Australian market's 90-day bank bill swap rate.
It was lead managed by the Commonwealth Bank and was the first to be issued in a Kangaroo structure -- meaning that it is a foreign debt raising in the Australian domestic market.
